title: Courier parcel with drugs → 'Mumbai Police' (English)
label: scam
notes: The 'parcel scam' variant: a fake courier call is transferred to a fake police officer on Skype.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Good morning madam, this call is from the courier company. A parcel booked in your name has been stopped by customs.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: A parcel? I did not send any parcel.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: The parcel to Taiwan contains five passports and 200 grams of MD drugs. I am connecting you to the Mumbai cyber crime police.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: This is DCP Rakesh Kumar, Mumbai Police cyber cell. Your Aadhaar is linked to illegal activities and a case is registered against you.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Sir, there must be some mistake.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Please join the Skype video call and stay in front of the camera for the investigation.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: This is a confidential matter. Do not tell anyone, not even your family, otherwise they will also be arrested.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Do not disconnect the call. If you cut the call, a team will arrest you within 30 minutes.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Okay sir, I am cooperating. What should I do?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: We need to verify your funds. Break your fixed deposits and transfer the money to the supervised account given by the RBI.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: After the verification is complete, the full amount will be refunded within 24 hours.
